reset_fee: surrender (if within risk limits) for a 75% discount code to restart at Phase 1; 1-Step Max includes up to 3 free restarts
max_risk_per_trade: 1.5% recommended guideline; hard 1% per-trade loss limit on 1-Step Max
inactivity_rule: Account breached after 30 days without a trade; reinstatement on request, not guaranteed
notes: Help centre says challenge fee is not refundable (firms.json notes an Oct 2026 promo refunding the fee with first payout — promo only). Surrender button gives 75% off a restart if drawdown use ≤70% and no single trade lost >1%; 1-Step Max/Career surrender gives a 100% code (up to 3 times). Flat $40 Riseworks processing fee per payout. KYC done after passing the evaluation, before Master account. Hedging inside one account allowed; group/cross-account hedging banned. Copy trading only between accounts you own; evals must be passed individually (one copied eval). Per-trade/daily gain limit $10K. EA policy for normal accounts not found (EAs banned only in monthly competition).
